method: Normalised OSM and Overture records were rebuilt in memory with the pipeline's own normalize/merge modules and mapped to published venues by id or alias. Checks: all 15 merged clusters; all 59 review-candidate pairs; every pair of published venues sharing a phone, an own-site host, a Facebook or Instagram page, a similar name within 300 m, or an identical squashed name within 30 km; an in-memory dry run with the web-research candidates. Judgements use only the source data and the research candidate files. Online lookups were not possible because the shared web-search budget was used up.

researchMerge.note: data/research/venues-researched.json did not exist at review time, so no web records are in the published catalogue. Predicted web merges come from an in-memory dry run that treats the 125 candidates in data/research/candidates/*.json as that file (65 importable, 32 clusters with a web record, 1 left ambiguous: Nairobi Club). Nothing was written.

fixtureResults.centroidPins: 4 groups of published venues share identical coordinates: Nairobi -1.28333, 36.8167 (3-4 venues); Kakamega 0.2833, 34.75; Mombasa -4.05, 39.6667; -1.28429, 36.8276. These are city-centroid geocodes. They make up 10 of the 43 proximity-only review pairs as pure noise, and they put pins in the wrong place.

ruleWeaknesses: STOP words lack place names and venue-type words: 'nairobi', 'kenya', 'hotel', 'yoga', 'gyms', 'gymnasium', 'sports', 'spa', 'aerobics' and 'wellness' all count as matching tokens. Results: the Bikram/Delight false merge and the predicted Eka/Jacaranda merge, plus 2 noisy name-near pairs (Fitness & Gym Kenya / Platinum Fitness Kenya).
Compound brand tokens are not split ('Smartgyms', 'NextLevel'), so obvious twins score Jaccard 0.
The name+distance rule has no veto for conflicting contacts: when both sides have their own phones and different Facebook pages, it still merges.

Web records placed on a town centroid get radius 8 km + 1 km in approxMatch, so any shared phone, website host or 0.5-Jaccard name merges them city-wide. sameWebsiteHost ignores the URL path, and chain branch pages (/branches/junction, /bamburi-branch/) share a host.
Identical names just outside 150 m (164 m, 270 m, 342 m, 437 m) go to review rather than merging. That is by design; the reviewer should settle them in data/overrides/merge.json.
